dishes.name: Stralsunder Fischbrötchen
dishes.desc: Soft roll with pickled herring, onion and remoulade, sold at the harbour. Stralsund's fastest meal and the best-known fish snack on the Baltic coast.

dishes.name: Bodden pike-perch
dishes.desc: Freshwater predator fish from the lagoons, pan-fried and served with potatoes. Standard fish dish at Rügen and Usedom inns.

dishes.name: Rügener Badejunge
dishes.desc: Soft cheese from Rügen, mild and creamy with a rind washed in a short brine. Made by an island dairy and sold in local shops.

dishes.name: Sea buckthorn cake
dishes.desc: Sponge cake with sharp orange sea buckthorn cream. The berry grows on Rügen's dunes and turns up in jam, ice cream and cakes.

dishes.name: Smoked Baltic flounder
dishes.desc: Flounder smoked warm over beech wood, eaten with bread. Sold fresh from the smokehouses on Rügen and Usedom.
